identification: Hand-coloured lithograph titled 'THE CATARACTS, LAUNCESTON', attributed in the lot title to Eugene von Guerard, image about 25 x 36 cm, in a ruled mount. No publisher or signature line visible. Von Guerard did not publish a Cataract Gorge plate in his known Australian Landscapes series (Ben Lomond, Epping Forest is the Tasmanian one), so this may be a later facsimile or another artist; attribution unverified.

entries.note: Von Guerard 'Ben Lomond, Epping Forest (Tasmania)', hand coloured lithograph, signed in plate, 33 x 51cm. Genuine signed-in-plate Tasmanian subject from the Australian Landscapes series; a different plate, and our lot shows no signature. Local database record, AUD, no conversion.

viewing_check: Look under the mount and at the margins for a signature or 'in plate' inscription, publisher or lithographer imprint (e.g. 'Day & Son', 'Hamel & Ebeling'), paper type and chain lines, dot-screen under a loupe (a modern halftone means reproduction), and whether colouring is by hand. Photograph the back and any labels.
